enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Snore. Turn to right side. Move arm. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Stretch legs. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe face with towel. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Take out cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Open drawer. Take out spoon. Close drawer. Pick up bowl. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in dishwasher. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out belt. Put on belt. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up phone. Check phone. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Check patient list. Visit patient room. Measure blood pressure. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Update chart. Attend meeting. Eat lunch. Return to ward. Assist doctor. Take vitals. Write notes. End shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Cook. Turn off stove. Take plate. Serve food. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Clear table. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Wipe counter.
Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up snack. Eat snack. Put down snack. Adjust volume. Change channel. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Type password. Open browser. Browse websites. Check email. Reply to email. Open document. Type document. Save document. Close browser. Shut down computer. Close laptop. Stand up.
Pick up book. Sit on sofa. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Adjust sitting position. Pick up cup. Drink tea. Put down cup. Read. Turn page. Close book. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Walk to bedroom.
Lie in bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Close eyes.
Lie on back. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
